page.layout: One block: a list of errata, set below a small head "ERRATA.", in the upper-middle of the page. A printer's ornament sits centred below it (not text). The faint upside-down text at the top is show-through from the other side and is not transcribed.
page.notes: The top block of inverted, blurred text is show-through from the reverse of the leaf and is left out. The errata lines are faint and only partly legible; the readings above are uncertain and the unclear words are marked illegible rather than guessed. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed. The central ornament is a printer's device, not text.
